scripts.build:extensions: npm run build && node scripts/export-chrome.mjs && node scripts/export-firefox.mjs
scripts.zip: npm run build:chrome && cd extensions/chrome && zip -r ../../swush-companion.zip . -x "*.map"
scripts.zip:chrome: npm run build:chrome && cd extensions/chrome && zip -r ../../swush-companion-chrome.zip . -x "*.map"
scripts.zip:firefox: npm run build:firefox && cd extensions/firefox && zip -r ../../swush-companion-firefox.zip . -x "*.map"
scripts.zip:source: rm -f swush-companion-source.zip && zip -r swush-companion-source.zip app public scripts package.json bun.lock vite.config.ts readme.md LICENSE .gitignore -x "*.map"
scripts.zip:extensions: npm run zip:chrome && npm run zip:firefox
scripts.release:firefox: npm run zip:firefox && npm run zip:source && npm run lint:firefox
